items.description: Google Maps mashup showing the worldwide coverage zones of Uber, Taxicab, Lyft, Juno, Via, Waze, Gett, and Carmel
Learn about the unknown hazards around you - the toxins you may be breathing. PlanetHazard maps over 86,000 companies throughout the US that emit hazardous air pollutants. Excellent mashup.
The Charlottetown Transit Map is a PHP and JavaScript application that uses Google Maps to display up-to-the-minute information about the buses in Charlottetown. From Peter Rukavina.
AyeDeals allows users to search 100s of e-commerce sites in a matter of seconds. The application utilizes multiple APIs, some of them include Etsy, Sears, Best Buy Products,..and more.
Flickrball is a fun six-degrees-of-separation scavenger-hunt game, using Flickr thumbnails and tags for clues.
Guidespot.com is about Conspiracy America. It is a coast-to-coast tour, a fun-filled look at the current state of National Paranoia.
